adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a bug in addGuests.handler.ts. At line 157-161, the code gets credentials using `ctx.user` (the caller) and creates an EventManager with those credentials. When an attendee adds guests (which is allowed per the permission check at lines 47-52), the calendar update will use the attendee's credentials instead of the organizer's. The organizer's calendar event won't be updated because the attendee doesn't have access to modify it. The code should use the booking.user's credentials (the organizer) for calendar updates, not the caller's credentials.
